analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md was supplied, as head-side text. No patch hunks, so added and unchanged lines can't be told apart, and no code behind the entries was provided. A changelog entry alone is not a concrete regression, and I report no findings. The changelog describes several changes the next pass should check against the code, and I did not review any of that code.

1. Cache routing persistence. Cache holders and observed demand are written to Postgres and restored after restart. Check that the persisted rows hold only the coordinator HMAC cache-salt scope, not raw chain hashes or prompts. Also check that the demand signal sent to providers as `cache_repeated_prefix_tokens` is scoped per account and not fleet-wide. Related threats are T-041 and SEC-035 (cross-tenant timing oracle) and T-003. T-041 does not yet describe this durable coordinator state.

2. SSD cache TTL and write demand. The 30-minute TTL is already recorded in T-041. The new rule 'write a checkpoint only on repeated-prefix demand' changes which prefixes reach disk. Confirm that SSDLookupKeys and the DBK3 AAD are unchanged.

3. Public model-demand statistics. Hourly aggregates are published, with a k-anonymity floor of 20 requests and 3 accounts. Verify the suppression logic, since it is new unauthenticated data exposure. It is not covered by T-051 or T-058.

4. Provider earnings lookup. The entry says the unauthenticated `/v1/provider/earnings?wallet=` lookup was removed, which closes T-031. If it holds, the threat model entry should be updated to mark it resolved.

5. App Attest, fail-closed challenges and floor changes. The changelog says protocol 3 only, a `status_signature` requirement, and fail-closed handling of an omitted `secure_boot_enabled`. Related threats are T-036, T-052..T-058 and TB-011. The floor change (`EIGENINFERENCE_MIN_PROVIDER_VERSION`) is a manual deploy step, so availability depends on operations.

6. Autopilot live control. It is observe-only by default, with session-bound control and unload-victim validation. It is new coordinator-to-provider command surface; check authorization and fencing. TB-002 and TB-011 may need an update.

7. Bank payout migration. Check atomic Checkout settlement, rejected-transfer refunds, and webhook verification across the two credential sets (TB-008, T-030).

8. Changelog entries for the PR-review tool and budget. These are operational only and cover state-writer tokens, funding preflight and spend caps. Funding details must stay out of logs.
